LZMA decoder (LzmaDec.c, LzmaDec.h, 7zTypes.h, Compiler.h, Precomp.h)
from the LZMA SDK by Igor Pavlov, taken from 7-Zip's repository
(https://github.com/ip7z/7zip, C/) on 2026-11-24.

The LZMA SDK is placed in the public domain: "Anyone is free to copy, modify,
publish, use, compile, sell, or distribute the original LZMA SDK code, either
in source code form or as a compiled binary, for any purpose, commercial or
non-commercial, and by any means." (https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html)

Battle at Antares uses it to read the headers of GOG's Windows installer.
